tracks.title: 始発を待つ
tracks.subject: waiting for the first train of the morning
tracks.caption: J-pop. Bright electric guitars with a fast strummed pattern, piano doubling the melody, a string section entering on the chorus, driving bass and a tight kit. A bright female voice sings high and clean with the precise syllable-to-note diction of Japanese pop, stacked harmonies on the hook and an anime-opening lift into the last chorus. Crisp modern mixing, wide stereo image. 138 BPM, D major. Energetic, hopeful, cinematic. no EDM drop.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Guitars]

[Verse 1]
終電を逃したのは わざとだよ
言えないまま 改札の前
きみの靴の先だけ 見ていた
始発まで あと四時間

[Pre-Chorus]
寒いね って言えば
近づける気がした

[Chorus]
始発を待つ この時間が
いちばん 好きだった
何も始まらないまま
何も終わらない場所

[Verse 2]
自販機のあたたかい缶を
二本買って 一本渡す
ありがとう の言い方が
少しだけ ちがった

[Guitar Solo]

[Chorus]
始発を待つ この時間が
いちばん 好きだった
何も始まらないまま
もう 終わってた場所

[Outro]
もうすぐ 朝だ
もうすぐ 朝だ

tracks.title: 海岸通り
tracks.subject: a coastal road at night
tracks.caption: 80s Japanese city pop. Funky sixteenth-note rhythm guitar, Rhodes electric piano with jazzy voicings, slap bass, warm analog synth pads and a synth-brass stab on the chorus, gated reverb on the snare. A husky female lead sings smoky and relaxed, sitting behind the beat, with light stacked harmonies. Warm analog saturation, wide stereo image. 106 BPM, F major. Nostalgic, urban, night-drive. no modern EDM, no trap hats.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes]

[Verse 1]
海岸通りを 窓開けて走る
潮の匂いが 髪にからむ
ラジオはずっと 同じ曲
誰も 変えようとしない

[Pre-Chorus]
このまま どこにも
着かなければいい

[Chorus]
夜の海は 何も映さない
だから 安心して隣にいる
言わなくていいことを
言わずに済む速度で

[Verse 2]
ガソリンのランプが ついた
きみは気づいて 黙ってる
あと少し あと少しって
ふたりとも 思ってる

[Synth Solo]

[Chorus]
夜の海は 何も映さない
だから 安心して隣にいる
言わなくていいことを
言えなくなる速度で

[Outro]
もう少しだけ
もう少しだけ

tracks.title: 北の宿
tracks.subject: an inn in the snow country
tracks.caption: Enka. Shakuhachi flute opens alone, koto answers, a string section swells under the chorus, slow brushed drums and upright bass. A female lead sings with the deep vibrato and kobushi ornamental turns of enka — the voice bends and trembles into the top of each phrase — strongly projected and sorrowful. Warm analog saturation, plate reverb, spacious. 64 BPM, A minor. Melancholy, formal, weathered. no western pop, no synth.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Shakuhachi]

[Verse 1]
雪が降る 北の宿
障子の向こう 白い息
あなたが座っていた場所に
座布団だけ 置いてある

[Pre-Chorus]
女将さんは 何も聞かない
それが やさしさ

[Chorus]
待つのが 女の仕事なら
私は 上手になりました
上手になるほど
遠くなる人

[Verse 2]
囲炉裏の火が 小さくなる
継ぎ足す薪は まだある
朝まで 燃やしておきます
あなたが 来なくても

[Koto Interlude]

[Chorus]
待つのが 女の仕事なら
私は 上手になりました
上手になるほど
もう 待ってない人

[Outro]
雪が降る
雪が降る

tracks.title: 工場の煙突
tracks.subject: a factory town
tracks.caption: Japanese indie rock, recorded live in one room. Two electric guitars — one clean and angular, one overdriven — driving eighth-note bass, dry drums with audible room bleed. A raspy male voice half-speaks the verses close to the mic and shouts the chorus without tuning. Raw live-room bleed, bone-dry drums, tape saturation on the bus. 146 BPM, E minor. Fast, frustrated, alive. no pop, no synth.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Guitars]

[Verse 1]
煙突の煙が まっすぐ上がる日は
風がない いい天気らしい
父はそう言って 毎朝出ていった
三十八年 同じ時間に

[Pre-Chorus]
煙突は去年 止まった
風は まだ吹いてる

[Chorus]
ここを出るって 言い続けて
結局 まだここにいる
出られないんじゃない
出る理由を 探してるだけ

[Verse 2]
同級生の半分は もういない
残った半分で 飲む
誰も 東京の話をしない
そういうルールになってる

[Guitar Solo]

[Chorus]
ここを出るって 言い続けて
結局 まだここにいる
出られないんじゃない
探すのを やめただけ

[Outro]
まだ ここにいる
まだ ここにいる

tracks.title: 六畳
tracks.subject: a six-mat room
tracks.caption: Japanese bedroom pop. A soft drum machine, muted electric guitar playing a looping figure, Rhodes chords, warm synth bass, continuous tape hiss. A soft male tenor sings breathy and very close to the mic, doubling himself loosely so the two takes drift slightly apart. Dusty vinyl texture, lo-fi intimacy, nothing bright. 92 BPM, C major. Small, warm, unhurried. no stadium reverb, no EDM.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes]

[Verse 1]
六畳の部屋に 全部ある
服も 本も 人生も
狭いって言われるけど
手を伸ばせば 届くのがいい

[Pre-Chorus]
窓のむこうに 隣の壁
それしか見えない

[Chorus]
ここで 十分だ
って言えるまで 五年かかった
何も増やしてないけど
何も減らしてもいない

[Verse 2]
洗濯物が 乾かない季節
部屋に干して 部屋が湿る
それでも ここが
いちばん 眠れる

[Chorus]
ここで 十分だ
って言えるまで 五年かかった
何も増やしてないけど
減らせたのかも しれない

[Outro]
十分だ
十分だ

tracks.title: 最終便
tracks.subject: the last flight of the night
tracks.caption: Japanese jazz fusion with a big band. Full brass section with tight stabs and a shout chorus, Rhodes comping extended chords, upright bass walking, drums riding brushes then sticks. A soulful male baritone sings the head, scats through the solo section and runs melismas out of it. Warm analog saturation, plate reverb, the room audible behind the horns. 118 BPM, B-flat major. Warm, loose, late. no pop, no electronic drums.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Brass]

[Verse 1]
最終便の待合室は
静かすぎて 音楽が要る
売店はもう 閉まってる
自販機だけが 光ってる

[Pre-Chorus]
遅れても 誰も怒らない時間

[Chorus]
最終便 最終便
乗ってしまえば もう戻れない
それが いいんだ
選んだことに したいから

[Scat Solo]
ドゥバディ バドゥダッ
シャバドゥワ

[Verse 2]
隣の席の人が 眠ってる
知らない人の 寝顔を見る
同じ場所へ 行く人
それだけで 少し安心する

[Brass Solo]

[Chorus]
最終便 最終便
乗ってしまえば もう戻れない
それが いいんだ
選んだことに するから

[Outro - Scat]
バドゥダッ ドゥバディ

tracks.title: アーケード
tracks.subject: a covered shopping arcade
tracks.caption: Shibuya-kei leaning synthpop. Analog synth bass, a bright arpeggiator running through the verses, glossy pad chords, a drum machine with a gated snare, hand claps, no live drums. A bright female voice sings clean and polished with a vocoder doubling the hook and a short spoken aside in the bridge. Crisp modern mixing, wide stereo image, shimmering. 124 BPM, A major. Cheerful, retro-futurist, slightly wistful.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Arpeggiator]

[Verse 1]
アーケードの屋根に 雨の音
中は いつでも晴れ
閉めたお店が 三軒増えた
看板だけ 残ってる

[Pre-Chorus]
子どものころは ここが
世界の全部だった

[Chorus]
アーケード アーケード
雨に濡れない道
まっすぐ歩けば 終わってしまう
だから ゆっくり歩く

[Verse 2]
くじ引きの機械は まだある
一回 二百円
当たったことは 一度もない
それでも 毎回やる

[Bridge - spoken]
また来るね
って 誰に言ってるんだろう

[Chorus - vocoder]
アーケード アーケード
雨に濡れない道
まっすぐ歩けば 終わってしまう
だから 立ち止まる

[Outro]
ゆっくり
ゆっくり

tracks.caption: Post-rock, largely instrumental. Warm analog saturation, plate reverb, close and unhurried. 86 BPM, E-flat major. Intimate, late, generous. no pop, no EDM.

tracks.title: 한강의 밤
tracks.subject: the river at night
tracks.caption: Korean city pop. Funky sixteenth-note rhythm guitar, Rhodes electric piano, slap bass, warm analog synth pads and a synth-brass hit on the chorus, gated snare. A smooth male tenor sings laid-back behind the beat and lifts into falsetto on the hook, with light stacked harmonies. Warm analog saturation, wide stereo image. 102 BPM, E-flat major. Nostalgic, breezy, night-lit. no modern EDM, no trap hats.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes]

[Verse 1]
한강에 앉으면
서울이 조용해져
뒤에서는 차가 달리는데
앞에서는 물만 흘러

여기만 시간이
다르게 가는 것 같아

한강의 밤은
아무것도 묻지 않아

치킨 상자를 들고
한 무리가 지나가
웃음소리가 물 위로
오래 남아

[Synth Solo]

[Chorus - falsetto]
한강의 밤은
아무것도 묻지 않아
그래서 다들 여기 앉아
혼자가 아닌 척 앉아 있어

[Outro]
조금만 더

tracks.title: 장독대
tracks.subject: the row of jars behind a house
tracks.caption: Korean gugak fusion. Gayageum zither opens alone with its characteristic bending of pitch after the pluck, daegeum bamboo flute answers, janggu hourglass drum marks the chorus, all over a modern string arrangement. A female voice sings with the wide vibrato and bent phrasing of Korean folk singing, ornamenting the ends of lines. Wide stereo image, cavernous reverb tails. 74 BPM, A minor pentatonic. Grave, rooted. no western pop, no synth.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Gayageum]

[Verse 1]
장독대에 항아리가 일곱
할머니가 여섯 개까지 셌어
일곱 번째는 안 세
그건 어머니 거니까

[Pre-Chorus]
뚜껑을 열면
삼 년 전 여름 냄새

[Chorus]
담가둔 것들은
기다릴수록 깊어진대
사람도 그러면 좋을 텐데
사람은 그냥 멀어지더라

[Verse 2]
비 오면 뚜껑을 덮고
해 나면 다시 열고
그게 다인 일을
평생 하신 분이 있었어

[Daegeum Solo]

[Chorus]
담가둔 것들은
기다릴수록 깊어진대
사람도 그러면 좋을 텐데
사람도 그런 건지도 몰라

[Outro]
일곱 개

tracks.title: 우산 두 개

tracks.caption: Korean folk, almost entirely acoustic. Fingerpicked steel-string guitar, upright bass entering in the second verse, brushed percussion, a single cello line under the bridge. tracks.title: 첫차
tracks.subject: the first bus of the morning
tracks.caption: Gospel soul sung in Korean. Hammond organ through a rotating speaker, upright piano, bass, live kit, tambourine on the backbeat, hand claps. A powerful female lead sings with heavy melisma and full belting; a choir answers each line in call and response and stacks harmonies under the final chorus, which modulates up a semitone. Live-room bleed, gospel-room reverb. 94 BPM, A-flat major. Rising, communal. no pop, no EDM.

[Verse 1]
첫차에는 다 아는 얼굴들

십 년째 그렇게

(같이 가) 같이 가

아무도 안 보는 시간에
